priorityPaymentsEnrollment.description: NEW flow added by the designer. Entered from home-connected.html's Priority Payments tab ('Set Up'). A 5-stage 'Set Up Payments' wizard: Select Vendor account, Confirm Address, Select Funding Account, Set Priority Payment Rules, Review and Enroll.

screens.role: Stage 1. Single-select checkbox table (checking one unchecks the rest) per the designer's explicit instruction. Cancel -> home-connected.html. Next -> pp-confirm-address.html

Stage 2. CONSOLIDATED: confirm -> validating (auto-advances) -> validated, all one page. Inline address editing in place of a modal (see README). Back -> pp-select-vendor.html. Next -> pp-select-funding.html
Stage 3. Funding account cards; 'View account info' opens a real in-page side sheet. Next -> pp-payment-rules.html

conventions.stageConsolidationPattern: Where several Figma frames are really just different states of one screen (dropdown open, toggle on/off, validating -> validated, etc.), they're built as ONE HTML file with .stage/.stage.active panels (or, where the states are truly just form control states, as one live form with real toggles/selects) switched by a small inline <script> — never as separate page navigations. This same pattern is used for: wizard-route-a/b/c/e.html, pp-confirm-address.html, pp-payment-rules.html, and invoice-detail.html.
